dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Symmetrical and continuous 2D narrowing from the widest mid-body point toward a pointed posterior terminus.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Minor asymmetrical deviation with a slightly more pronounced outward curve on the right lateral margin compared to the left.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Medium-grey with a consistent cool-toned reflectance across the primary dorsal area.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-density, diffuse darker grey patches distributed along the lateral boundaries and near the anterior apex.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Soft, diffuse gradient transitions between the primary grey baseline and darker pigmented patches.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A single thin, dark linear marking is visible on the anterior-left dorsal quadrant.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: One visible dark linear mark or scratch on the left lateral-dorsal surface.
other_distinctive_markers: A prominent, high-contrast dark circular feature located centrally in the anterior region.
